theorems.name: Submission.cone_current_imrep_measure_smul_image
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * R.measure A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
